blocks.content:
This was made as an exercise for body mechanics and timing.
This isn’t the first time I’ve animated a dance; in fact, one of the pieces from my demo reel coming out of school was a dance

right.content:
I find learning to animate dances is a pretty neat way to learn body mechanics being that its all fluid motions.
And in fact, what better way to update my demo reel by doing another dance.

blocks.content:
Since there is a never ending pool of dance videos that come out every year, the sky’s the limit.
I have decided this time around, to use <rgr>WOKE UP</rgr> by XG as the subject of the exercise.
